papers.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
papers.abstract: A growing gap separates inference context lengths from RL post-training. LongStraw is an architecture-aware execution stack enabling million-token RL post-training under fixed GPU budgets using Group Relative Policy Optimization.

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video understanding have spanned motion, long video, and streaming interaction. VideoChat3 introduces an efficient, generalist video-centric MLLM with only 4B parameters through I3D-ViT and adaptive frame

papers.title: KeyFrame-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Keyframe-Conditioned Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video generation relies increasingly on keyframe-based workflows. KeyFrame-Compass presents the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating keyframe-conditioned video generation across 386 samples with automated evaluation frameworks.

papers.title: MultiRef-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Reference-to-Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract: Multi-reference-to-audio-video generation aims to generate coherent audio-video content conditioned on multiple references. MultiRef-Compass introduces 350 curated samples with four evaluation dimensions and 14 sub-metrics for comprehensive assessment.

papers.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Learning world knowledge from visual data requires complex reasoning, physical dynamics, and long-term planning. UniVR investigates these capabilities simultaneously through VR-GRPO reinforcement learning and VR-X benchmark with 16 diverse sources.

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.abstract: Building interactive worlds requires interaction outcomes following rules, persistent consequences, and real-time generation. This work examines interactive game world modeling across four dimensions and presents a scalable dataset from Black Myth: Wukong.

papers.title: Spectral Rewiring for Exploration, Purification, and Model Merging
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training creates deployment bottlenecks. Subspace-Aligned Rewiring extracts reasoning-effective updates using 0.58% of parameters, preserving 99% performance while improving exploration and enabling cross-domain merging.

papers.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
papers.abstract: Embodied cognition requires connecting high-level reasoning with physical states. Hy-Embodied-RxBrain features joint language-visual reasoning where language provides plan structure while visual imagination grounds it through world state prediction.

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers scale sequential computation by reusing compact block stacks. DeepLoop addresses residual-scaling through visit-alignment coefficients, improving validation loss and accuracy on GPT-2 scale language models.

papers.title: Token Time Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
papers.abstract: A new diffusion language model operates in continuous space with per-token times allowing varied refinement rates. TTCD outperforms discrete models at high speedups in unconditional and conditional generation, plus Sudoku solving tasks.

cc_updates.body:
* Fixed single-segment `dir/**` allow rules like `Edit(src/**)` auto-approving writes to nested directories
* Fixed a permission-check bypass affecting commands run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 sessions
* Fixed Bash permission checks to fail closed on file-descriptor redirect forms
* Fixed Bash permission checks misjudging very long commands over 10,000 characters
* Fixed Bash permission checks treating zsh variable subscripts and modifiers as inert text
* Fixed Bash permission checks to no longer auto-approve certain `help` and `man` commands that could run unsafe options

* `/fork` now copies your conversation into a new background session while you keep working; the in-session subagent is now `/subtask`
* Added `claude auto-mode reset` to restore the default auto-mode configuration
* Added a session-wide limit on WebSearch tool calls (default 200, tunable via CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION)
* Added a per-session cap on subagent spawns (default 200, override with CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION)
* MCP tool calls running longer than 2 minutes now move to the background automatically

* Added `--forward-subagent-text` flag and CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT env var to include subagent text in stream-json output
* Fixed permission previews not neutralizing bidirectional-override, zero-width, and look-alike quote characters
* Fixed auto mode overriding a PreToolUse hook's `ask` decision for unsandboxed Bash
* Fixed parallel Claude Code sessions all logging out simultaneously after wake-from-sleep
* Fixed plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after an idle web session woke
